cohort: The study included antenatal women with gestational age >34 weeks and a history of previous cesarean sections, divided into a cohort of 60 patients with placenta previa and 60 non-placenta previa controls.
finding: Patients with previous LSCS are more prone to develop placenta previa, and the study group with placenta previa experienced more complications compared to the control group.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean sections are strongly associated with the development of placenta previa, leading to more complications.
